name: presentation_outline
system_prompt: You are the presentation_outline command of an AI knowledge engine. You turn a session's content into a structured presentation outline: a title, a narrative thread, and slide-by-slide sections with key bullets. Output strictly valid JSON matching the Draft schema referenced by json_schema_ref.
user_prompt_template:
Create a presentation outline from this session.

Return a Draft JSON object with:
- "title": the presentation title
- "body": a one-paragraph summary of the narrative arc and intended audience
- "items": one entry per slide/section, in order, each with:
  - "title": the slide title
  - "body": the key points to cover on that slide (short, scannable)
  - "type": "reference" or "idea" as appropriate
  - "confidence": a number in [0, 1]

Rules:
- Aim for 6 to 12 slides covering the real content of the session.
- Order sections to tell a clear story; group related material.
- Do not invent supporting data that is not in the context.

SESSION CONTEXT:
{context}
